column3: Nearly repeats the prepared earth and traversable paths, clarifying their orientation-bearing purpose.
Within the same discourse, it frames creation as each thing receiving its form and guidance.
The negative resting-place image adds no useful relation to the earth, water, or vegetation sequence.
Closely parallels prepared earth, heaven, descending water, and provision emerging from it.
The immediate continuation shows the resulting vegetation as nourishment for people and livestock.
Its disputed claim about a way concerns conduct toward others, not the focus scene.
Connects sky-water-driven gardens with exclusive divine creative agency.
Names the creator of heaven and earth but adds none of the focus ayah's enacted sequence.
Musa's mission of leading people from darkness to light supplies a distinct guidance context.
Its water-to-fruits sequence foregrounds visible variation among what emerges.
The next ayah extends earth's role into human origin, return, and renewed emergence.
Gives a compact water-to-grain-and-vegetation parallel, though it is already well represented.
